prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Keeping the baseline cut/balance/binarisation backbone untouched, adding a case-relative criticality-weighted net-cut multiplier (1 + alpha * mean-pin criticality rank) steers only the few most timing-critical nets to stay within a tier, reducing crit-pair cross-tier and hence TNS, while alpha is kept small so non-critical nets are not sacrificed.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-0.498 robust(mean-std)=-0.222 min_case=-0.223 seed_std=0.349 tns_mean=-0.119 all_valid=True
  C1: score=-0.090 dWNS=-9.3% dTNS=-4.3% per-seed=[+0.11 -0.57 +0.19]
  C2: score=-0.223 dWNS=-27.0% dTNS=-18.9% per-seed=[+0.11 -0.47 -0.31]
  C3: score=-0.185 dWNS=-27.3% dTNS=-8.1% per-seed=[+0.45 -0.38 -0.63]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->128, wcut 421->401, crit_cross 0.011->0.104, repair_flips 103->79, changed-vs-baseline 21.1%
  C2: cut 318->314, wcut 1007->1047, crit_cross 0.000->0.097, repair_flips 238->189, changed-vs-baseline 31.2%
  C3: cut 582->555, wcut 1955->1849, crit_cross 0.069->0.112, repair_flips 353->314, changed-vs-baseline 33.5%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: Hypothesis failed: crit_cross rose in all circuits (C1 0.011→0.104, C2 0.000→0.097, C3 0.069→0.112) despite lower cut/wcut and fewer repair flips—criticality weighting apparently perturbed the backbone away from timing-critical containment, worsening dWNS (−9 to −27%) and dTNS. Seed spread is unacceptable (std 0.349; per-seed signs flip, e.g. C3 +0.45/−0.63). Next: verify the criticality rank is correctly aligned with crit-pair membership and sweep alpha downward (or gate the multiplier only on nets already near-tier-boundary) before retraining.
